title: 第18章 勇者胜
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
尖锐的嘶鸣声炸开。

    猎影蛛疯狂蹬地，八条蛛足乱窜，刺穿旁边的货架，金属铁皮被捅出几个窟窿。

    就连地面也被刮出深深的沟槽，碎屑飞溅。

    然而绵密粘稠的粘网却扯住了它的蛛足，让它难以挣扎，而糊住面部和前肢的粘网更是让它无法辨别方向。

    陈峰立刻抓起灭巢烟弹，拉开保险销环，沿着从储物间门底的缝隙丢了出去。

    圆柱体在地面上咕噜噜滚了两圈，停在猎影蛛腹部正下方。

    嗤——！

    灰白色的浓烟从烟弹顶部喷涌而出，瞬间填满了小卖部的下半部分空间。

    猎影蛛的嘶鸣声变得嘶哑，挣扎的幅度骤然减弱。

    它的呼吸孔在腹部两侧，直接吸入了毒烟。

    随后身形动作逐渐从疯狂变成了迟缓，最后变成了逐渐的抽搐。

    就是现在！

    陈峰目光猛地一凝，从储物间冲出来。

    他贴着墙体迅速绕向猎影蛛的侧后方，双手握紧斩刀，刀尖对准猎影蛛腹部末端，全力刺入！

    这里是猎影蛛全身最薄弱的区域，甲壳最薄。

    要知道，如今的陈峰早已今非昔比，踏入淬体中期后暴涨的力量，足以让他轻而易举的洞穿猎影蛛的甲壳。

    更别说还有刚刚到手的锋锐斩刀。

    噗！

    刀刃轻而易举的破开腹部软壳，没入将近半尺。

    温热的组织液顺着刀身喷涌而出，溅了他一身。

    “吱——”

    猎影蛛的身体猛地弓起，发出一声撕裂般的嘶吼。

    八条蛛足同时暴起，力量似乎再度增加了不少，身上的粘网被一下撕裂！

    “靠！”

    陈峰心头一紧，拔刀后撤。

    一根触肢擦着他的肩膀甩过去，带起的风压刮得防护服猎猎作响。

    他连退几步，立刻拉开距离。

    猎影蛛拖着残破的粘网转过身来，六条还能动的腿撑着地面，身体压低，口器疯狂剪合。

    下一刻，便朝着陈峰扑来！

    巨大的身躯，裹挟着狂暴的气势，如同山岳一样压过来。

    陈峰心中一惊，下意识便想要避让退开。

    然而刚退半步，他便察觉到什么。

    不对！

    这头猎影蛛不是要搏命，而是要逃跑！

    自己身后就是大门，若是让开，它便可夺门跑路！

    要知道，猎影蛛速度极快，一旦脱离这片狭窄空间，自己便再也不可能追上它！

    而且更麻烦的是，

    猎影蛛这种生物极为记仇，一旦被它盯上，便会一直追踪气味，暗中潜伏，时刻寻找一击必杀的机会。

    一想到今后自己在大墟中行走，背后时刻有一头这样的怪物如跗骨之疽一样尾随自己，
content_en:
A sharp hissing sound exploded.

    The shadow hunter spider kicked the ground wildly, its eight spider legs scurrying around, piercing the shelves next to it, and punching several holes in the metal sheet.

    Even the ground was scraped with deep grooves and debris flew.

    However, the dense and sticky web grabbed its spider legs, making it difficult for it to struggle, and the sticky web covering its face and forelimbs made it even harder for it to discern its direction.

    Chen Feng immediately grabbed the nest-killing cigarette bomb, opened the safety pin ring, and threw it out along the gap at the bottom of the storage room door.

    The cylinder rolled twice on the ground and stopped right under the abdomen of the shadow hunter spider.

    laugh--!

    Thick gray smoke spurted out from the top of the cartridge, instantly filling the lower half of the canteen.

    The shadow-hunting spider's scream became hoarse, and the intensity of its struggle suddenly weakened.

    Its breathing holes are on both sides of its abdomen, and it directly inhales poisonous smoke.

    Then the body movements gradually changed from crazy to sluggish, and finally turned into gradual twitching.

    That's it now!

    Chen Feng's eyes suddenly condensed and he rushed out of the storage room.

    He quickly moved around the side and rear of the Shadow Hunter Spider against the wall, holding the chopping knife with both hands, aiming the tip of the knife at the end of the Shadow Hunter Spider's abdomen, and stabbed in with all his strength!

    This is the weakest area of ​​the Shadow Hunter Spider's body, with the thinnest carapace.

    You must know that Chen Feng is no longer what he used to be. The surge in strength after entering the middle stage of body tempering is enough for him to easily penetrate the carapace of the Shadow Hunter Spider.

    Not to mention the sharp sword that he just got.

    puff!

    The blade easily broke through the soft shell of the abdomen and penetrated nearly half a foot.

    Warm tissue fluid spurted out along the blade and splashed all over him.

    "Squeak——"

    The Shadow Hunter Spider's body arched suddenly and let out a tearing roar.

    The eight spider legs burst out at the same time, and the strength seemed to have increased a lot again, and the sticky web on the body was torn apart!

    "Fuck!"

    Chen Feng's heart tightened and he drew his sword and retreated.

    A tentacle brushed against his shoulder and the wind pressure caused the protective suit to squeak.

    He took a few steps back and immediately distanced himself.

    The shadow hunter spider dragged the broken sticky web around and turned around. Its six movable legs were supporting the ground, its body was lowered, and its mouthparts were scissoring wildly.

    The next moment, he rushed towards Chen Feng!

    The huge body, carrying a violent momentum, pressed over like a mountain.

    Chen Feng was startled and subconsciously wanted to move away.

    However, as soon as he took half a step back, he noticed something.

    wrong!

    This shadow hunting spider is not trying to fight for its life, but trying to escape!

    There is a door behind him. If he gives way, it can seize the door and run away!

    You know, the Shadow Hunter Spider is extremely fast. Once it leaves this narrow space, you will never be able to catch up with it!

    And what's even more troublesome is,

    Creatures like the Shadow Hunter Spider are extremely vengeful. Once targeted, they will keep tracking the scent and lurk in secret, always looking for an opportunity to kill with one strike.

    When I think about walking in the ruins from now on, there will always be such a monster following me like a tarsal gangrene,
